headline: FCC clears SpaceX's 1M-satellite orbital data centers; Nvidia swing rocks markets
bottomLine: SpaceX won FCC approval for up to 1M orbital data-center satellites while facing Tesla merger talks, Grok suits and a Dec 8 unlock; Erebor topped $1B in loans. Nvidia's CEO reversal whipsawed AI stocks, Anthropic fell below its IPO price and bitcoin neared $60K.

portfolio.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind data-center satellites
portfolio.brief: The FCC conditionally approved the solar-powered orbital AI constellation on Nov 25, with backup radio links, more safety data for higher orbits and a 2040 deadline. Scientists are skeptical (NPR).
portfolio.impact: A license turns orbital compute from pitch into a permitted plan, a way around strained power grids on Earth. The 2040 deadline and scientists' doubts mean no near-term revenue.
portfolio.action: Ask SpaceX contacts by Wed Dec 3 which FCC conditions bind first, when first launches start, and what capex the grant implies.

portfolio.brief: Perplexity released Time Machine, letting AI agents search the web as it was in the past, and a Monitor API that turns search into continuous watching. Pro plans now carry weekly agent usage limits.
portfolio.impact: Point-in-time retrieval and monitoring are infrastructure agents need, moving Perplexity beyond a search app. The usage caps show agent compute costs still bind.

regulation.title: CFTC staff: crypto can count toward firms' reserves, but not liquidity buffers
regulation.brief: A CFTC staff advisory says crypto assets can count as financial resources for reserve requirements, but not toward liquidity-buffer requirements.
regulation.impact: A partial opening: regulated firms can hold crypto as operating capital, which validates it as a balance-sheet asset. The carve-out shows regulators still treat it as less liquid than cash.
regulation.next: Staff advisory in effect now; no formal rule date announced

macro.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock jumps 31% then gives back 8%

macro.impact: The 31% day and 8% giveback show AI valuations resting on one executive and White House goodwill. With probes still open, expect Nvidia-linked rounds to reprice on each headline.
macro.action: Ask Perplexity by Fri Dec 5 whether the Nvidia swing changed the timing or terms of its pending Nvidia-linked round.
